visual.name: atlynProfileLens
visual.description: Compare report-bound measures through a fixed-center viewport lens over professional offline world and US cartography, points, strict bound geometry, or generated context. Built-in reference layers remain noninteractive; the visual bundles no observations, makes no external requests, and requests no privileges.

en-US.Role_Hierarchy_Description: Ordered grouping fields: entity first, then an optional period, then the ordered band.
en-US.Role_Series_Description: Optional split with at most two rendered values.
en-US.Role_Profiles_Description: One to six numeric measures. Each measure becomes one profile arm.
en-US.Role_ContextValue_Description: Optional entity-level value used by context features and tooltips.
en-US.Role_Latitude_Description: Optional WGS84 latitude measure for bound point context.
en-US.Role_Longitude_Description: Optional WGS84 longitude measure for bound point context.
en-US.Role_Geometry_Description: Optional strict GeoJSON or WKT text measure for report-bound context.
en-US.Role_Tooltips_Description: Additional fields shown in the native tooltip.
en-US.Format_PackKeyMode_Canonical: World ISO alpha-3 or NE: fallback
en-US.Format_NavigationEnabled_Description: Automatic enables the fixed-center viewport lens for interactive multi-feature Context scenes. Legacy false and true values remain Off and On.
en-US.Format_HomeView_Description: Automatic fills geographic contexts and fits generated or non-navigable contexts. Fit shows the full extent; Fill starts closer while keeping Minimum zoom reachable.
en-US.Format_HomeFocus_Description: Automatic centers Home on a bound Entity that has profile data so the center probe opens on a populated profile. Scene center keeps the previous geometric center of the whole context.
en-US.Format_ShowNoDataBackdrop_Description: Hide unbound base paint while retaining complete probe, navigation, picking, and semantic geometry.
en-US.Format_ProbeAnnouncementVerbosity_Descri: Choose concise state changes or detailed source and data-coverage announcements.
en-US.Format_FallbackEntityKey_Description: Exact raw text of one loaded bound Entity to show only when the probe is over no Context feature.
en-US.Format_ShowValueLabels_Description: Shows the value of each band on the chart. Values appear at the largest size tier only, where there is room to read them.
en-US.Format_ShowLensScrim_Description: Dims the cartography around a clear circular aperture at the center probe so the chart reads as a lens over the map. Applies to the Focus lens layout only.
en-US.Landing_Subtitle: Compare up to six report measures across ordered bands.
en-US.Landing_Step_Entity: 1. Add an entity field to Entity > Period > Band.
en-US.Landing_Step_Period: 2. Optionally add a period field as the second hierarchy field.
en-US.Landing_Step_Band: 3. Add the ordered band field as the last hierarchy field.
en-US.Landing_Step_Profile: 4. Add one to six numeric measures to Profile measures.
en-US.Landing_Step_Optional: 5. Optionally add Series, Tooltips, or context fields.
en-US.Landing_Note_ProfileOnly: Context is optional. Built-in packs are offline cartographic resources; the visual makes no external requests.
en-US.Landing_Note_DataSource: All analytical values come from fields you bind. Packs contain geometry, exact keys, names, source status, centroids, adjacency, and attribution only.
en-US.Landing_Note_PackKeys: Built-in keys are exact text: world USA or NE:KOS; state 06; county 06037. Names, numeric padding, trimming, and fuzzy matching are not supported.
en-US.Landing_Note_PackPolicy: World boundaries follow Natural Earth 5.1.1 de facto source policy. Census 2025 DC and territories are included through explicit cartographic insets.
en-US.Status_Partial: Partial data is displayed while more segments load.
en-US.Status_Failed: The visual could not render this data view.
en-US.EntityList_Empty: No entities in the current filter context.
en-US.Navigation_ProbeDescription: The fixed center probe resolves the Context feature beneath it and updates the local profile while the viewport moves.
en-US.Navigation_GestureHelp: Drag to pan. Scroll or pinch to zoom (page scrolls when zoom limits are reached). Use Shift plus Arrow to pan, plus or minus to zoom, and Home to reset.
en-US.Context_NoData: No data in current report context
en-US.Context_Unloaded: Profile detail is not loaded in the current DataView
en-US.Context_NoFeature: No Context feature at the center probe
en-US.Context_FallbackInvalid: The configured fallback Entity key does not resolve to one unique loaded bound text Entity.
en-US.Context_SelectionRejected: Power BI rejected the selection. Local focus is unchanged.
en-US.Context_AnnouncementNoData: Probe: {0}. No data in current report context.
en-US.Context_AnnouncementUnloaded: Probe: {0}. Profile detail is not loaded in the current DataView.
en-US.Context_AnnouncementFallback: Probe: no Context feature. Showing configured fallback Entity {0}.
en-US.Context_Coverage: {0} loaded, {1} matched, {2} unloaded, {3} no-data backdrop features.
en-US.Empty_Guidance_MoveProbe: Drag the map so the center probe sits over a region that has data, or set a fallback Entity key.
en-US.Empty_Guidance_Unloaded: Load more detail for this feature, or move the center probe to a feature that is already loaded.
en-US.Empty_Guidance_NoValues: Adjust the report filters so the selected entity has profile values.
en-US.Diagnostic_NeedsEntity: Add an entity field to the hierarchy well.
en-US.Diagnostic_NeedsBand: Add an ordered band field as the last hierarchy field.
en-US.Diagnostic_NeedsProfile: Add at least one numeric measure to Profile measures.
en-US.Diagnostic_HierarchyDepthUnsupported: The hierarchy well accepts at most three fields; received {0}.
en-US.Diagnostic_ProfilesOverLimit: Received {0} profile measures and kept {1}. Remove measures to show them all.
en-US.Diagnostic_SeriesOverLimit: Received {0} series values and rendered {1}. Filter the series field to two values.
en-US.Diagnostic_DuplicateCells: Rejected {0} duplicate entity, period, band and series cells.
en-US.Diagnostic_BlankValues: {0} values are blank and are drawn as missing.
en-US.Diagnostic_NegativeProfileValues: Rejected {0} negative profile values. Profile measures must be zero or greater.
en-US.Diagnostic_ZeroDenominator: {0} values have a zero or negative denominator and cannot be normalized.
en-US.Diagnostic_PartialData: Partial data: {0} segments loaded, {1} values retained.
en-US.Diagnostic_SegmentLimitReached: Stopped after {0} segments, the configured maximum of {1}.
en-US.Diagnostic_HighlightActive: Cross highlighting is active; unhighlighted values are dimmed.
en-US.Diagnostic_InteractionsDisabled: Report interactions are disabled for this view.
en-US.Diagnostic_ExtensionRolesProfileOnly: Context fields are bound: {0}. Choose a compatible Context provider to render them.
en-US.Diagnostic_InvalidCoordinates: Rejected {0} coordinate values outside the valid latitude or longitude range.
en-US.Diagnostic_ConflictingCoordinates: Rejected {0} conflicting coordinates for one entity.
en-US.Diagnostic_IncompleteCoordinates: {0} entities have only one of latitude and longitude.
en-US.Diagnostic_OversizedGeometry: Rejected {0} geometry strings above the configured character limit.
en-US.Diagnostic_GeometryUpdateBudgetExceeded: Rejected geometry after the 2,000,000-character visual safety budget for one update was reached.
en-US.Diagnostic_GeometryParseRejected: Rejected {0} geometry values that do not match the strict supported GeoJSON or WKT grammar.
en-US.Diagnostic_GeometryRingLimit: Rejected {0} geometry values that exceed the ring limit.
en-US.Diagnostic_GeometryVertexLimit: Rejected {0} geometry values that exceed a vertex limit.
en-US.Diagnostic_ContextProviderUnavailable: The selected Context provider has no compatible bound input.
en-US.Diagnostic_ContextScenePartial: Context is partial because {0} features were rejected.
en-US.Diagnostic_MalformedPackKey: Rejected malformed pack keys. Use exact text such as USA, NE:KOS, 06, or 06037.
en-US.Diagnostic_UnsupportedPackKey: Rejected keys unsupported by the selected pack key mode.
en-US.Diagnostic_UnmatchedPackKey: No exact feature matched these keys in the selected pack.
en-US.Diagnostic_DuplicatePackKey: Rejected duplicate normalized pack keys to avoid ambiguous selection identities.
en-US.Diagnostic_PackArtifactInvalid: The selected built-in context pack is unavailable or invalid.
en-US.Diagnostic_FallbackEntityInvalid: The configured fallback Entity key does not resolve to one unique loaded bound text Entity.
en-US.Diagnostic_HostSelectionRejected: Power BI rejected the selection. Local focus is unchanged.
